description: Each validation rule rejects one row (missing/blank-only TRANSACTION_ID, missing ACCOUNT_ID, missing amount, |amount| > 1e7 both signs, invalid / blank / lower-case type, future date, multi-rule failure); boundary rows pass (|amount| = 1e7, date = run date, earlier date, missing date). The missing-date row sorts first in its BY group.

RETAIN running balance across all ten valid types in two accounts: reset at FIRST.ACCOUNT_ID, credit/debit/signed groups, negative amount on a debit type (abs), missing-date row first, same-date ties ordered by TRANSACTION_ID; second account goes overdrawn (OVERDRAFT outranks LARGE_WITHDRAWAL).

LEFT JOIN to STG_BANK.CUST_ACCOUNTS_DAILY: duplicated snapshot row (fan-out), missing CUSTOMER_ID (ORPHAN_ACCOUNT reached), missing CURRENT_BALANCE (missing propagates to POST/RUNNING_BALANCE -> OVERDRAFT), orphan WDR where LARGE_WITHDRAWAL outranks ORPHAN, account absent from snapshot with history (HIGH_AMOUNT despite missing balance) and without history (OVERDRAFT).

PROC SQL history statistics: 90-day lower bound inclusive (02NOV2023 in, 01NOV2023 out), missing-date history excluded, history dated after the run date included (no upper bound), STD = 0, single history row (STD missing), missing history amount ignored by AVG/STD, no history; Z_SCORE exactly 3 is not HIGH_AMOUNT.

Anomaly CASE boundaries and priority: WDR exactly 0.9 x PRE (not LARGE_WITHDRAWAL) vs just above, RUNNING_BALANCE exactly 0 (not OVERDRAFT), HIGH_AMOUNT outranks OVERDRAFT and LARGE_WITHDRAWAL, OVERDRAFT outranks LARGE_WITHDRAWAL after an earlier credit, LARGE_WITHDRAWAL tests the snapshot PRE balance not the running balance.
